mapper.insert: insert into sys_audit_log(operator_id, operator_role, module, action, target_type, target_id, detail, ip) values(#{operatorId}, #{operatorRole}, #{module}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{detail}, #{ip})
mapper.select: select * from sys_audit_log order by id desc limit #{pageSize} offset #{offset}
select * from sys_audit_log where id=#{id} limit 1
